mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the t-test p-value for the mean return difference is above 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand environment, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal fails to materialize in more than 55% of interaction-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% annually), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) signals overheating and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction (HOUST) falls below 700,000 units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where HOUST < 700, or the t-test p-value for the mean return difference is above 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE < 8.5% and declining), a rising employment growth rate (PAYEMS rising > 0.5% monthly) signals improving corporate hiring and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 8.5% AND UNRATE declining > 0.2pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS rising > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where INDPRO < 95.0, or the t-test p-value for the mean return difference is above 0.05.
